answer: The strongest single control I know for this is seasonal reputation reset with carryover cap, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 504 pays 7056 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The marble sits in the mechanism itself, the karst sits in the price of faking it, and the gale sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
